Patrol Compton

Put on the uniform and work a full shift as a Los Angeles County Sheriff’s deputy in Compton.

🚓 Start your shift. Suit up in the locker room, draw your gear from the armory, attend briefing, then take a cruiser out of the garage.

📻 Answer calls. Dispatch sends you calls around the city: traffic stops, disturbances, domestics, shots fired and more. Every call is run by AI, so there’s always work, whether the server is full or empty.

🗣️ Handle every contact your way. Run IDs, search, cite, warn or arrest. Suspects may cooperate, argue, fight or run.

🚨 Get backup. Request backup and other deputies can attach to your call. AI deputies roll up when nobody else is free.

🚔 Book them in. Transport arrests to the station, then fingerprint, book and process them.

⭐ Build a career. Earn XP and pay, pass promotion exams, and climb from Trainee to Sheriff.

Civilian team coming soon.
